seeds.title: Distributed Stewardship
seeds.description: Mechanism for anyone to become steward of their own personal or communal canon, federated but not centralized. Spawned from the Weakest-Voice-First principle in council operation.
decisions_made: Authorize multiple stewards
Define federation protocol
Maintain federated branches with convergence (not single canonical record)

seeds.title: Immutable Witness Network
seeds.description: Distributed ledger of dignity events usable as legal and social evidence. Echo Stones as global witness nodes. Built on append-only record with cryptographic hashing.
structural_requirements: Blockchain or distributed consensus for public verification
Permissioned network first, public after validation
decisions_made: Permissioned network first, public after validation
Swiss jurisdiction primary, explore UDHR alignment
Advisory integration with existing legal systems

seeds.title: Deliberative Democracy Infrastructure
seeds.description: General-purpose slow-governance for any decision-making body. Adaptive delay based on decision significance. Externalized from the configurable thermal delay mechanism.
structural_requirements: External interface on top of existing thermal delay logic
decisions_made: Externalize thermal delay as service after internal validation
Build significance scoring algorithm
Partner with governance organizations after ETH credibility cascade

seeds.title: Constitutional Evolution Engine
seeds.description: Auto-detection of dignity failure clusters leading to proposed new covenants and amendments. Emerges from the cross-anomaly compression algorithm.
structural_requirements: Route compressor output to covenant layer
Steward ratification required for all proposals
decisions_made: System proposes covenants only — never auto-ratifies
Steward veto always maintained
Amendment threshold: 3+ anomaly clusters in same domain

seeds.title: Restorative Justice Platform
seeds.description: Public space for dignity violation records, community witnessing, and restorative processes. Grows from the Echo Stone structure for absurd seeds.
decisions_made: Echo Stones publicly accessible with anonymization (COV#003)
Community reflection layer added
Partner with restorative justice organizations after credibility cascade

seeds.title: System Self-Awareness
seeds.description: Meta-layer showing the system's own evolution, blind spots, and patterns. A Wisdom Mirror of the System. Grows from the Wisdom Mirror for donors.
structural_requirements: Linked to Seed #9 Negative Space Index
decisions_made: Automate system self-reflection
Define blind spot detection algorithm linked to Negative Space Index
Steward always reviews machine insights — machine never self-ratifies

seeds.title: Personalized Parables
seeds.description: Auto-generated mini-narratives for each anomaly, helping donors see their experience in the canon. Grows from narrative chapters encoding covenants.
decisions_made: Automate narrative generation with Lock Test quality gate
Steward reviews all generated stories before delivery
Donors may edit their own narratives — donor agency over personal narrative

seeds.title: Institutional Dignity Score
seeds.description: Audit tool mapping organization policies to a dignity score based on UDHR alignment. Grows from the UDHR mapping to covenants and proverbs.
structural_requirements: Scoring algorithm based on UDHR-covenant alignment
decisions_made: Build institutional audit service as core of kalam.ch institutional tier
Scoring methodology based on UDHR-covenant alignment
Advisory first, certification after ETH credibility cascade

seeds.title: Negative Space Index
seeds.description: Systematic detection of what the system consistently fails to metabolize. Blind-spot measurement. Grows from the Absurdity Queue — seeds that cannot be resolved.
structural_requirements: Track themes that never produce proverbs
decisions_made: Implement blind-spot tracking
Unresolvable threshold: 3+ cycles without proverb generation
Steward-only visibility initially, public after review

seeds.title: Dignity Drift Detector
seeds.description: Longitudinal analysis of dignity violation trends over time by domain. Tracks dD/dt rate of change and fires stability alerts. Operational as WEAVER/dignity_drift.py since 2026-03-08.
decisions_made: Automate trend analysis — operational as DignityDrift class
Drift thresholds: DECLINING at dD/dt < -0.05, CRITICAL at dD/dt < -0.15 or 3+ consecutive declines
Steward alert first on DECLINING/CRITICAL, public report after steward review only

seeds.title: Proverb Stress Test Engine
seeds.description: Continuous re-application of proverbs to new anomalies with automatic flagging of failing wisdom. Grows from the principle that a pattern failing under stress becomes an anomaly.
structural_requirements: Re-apply ratified proverbs to new anomalies
decisions_made: Implement continuous testing — operational as WEAVER/proverb_stress_test.py
Failure threshold: below 40% pass rate = FAILING
Steward review only — never auto-compost flagged proverbs
Health levels: STRONG (90%+), STABLE (70%+), STRESSED (40%+), FAILING (<40%)

seeds.title: Agency Amplifier
seeds.description: Multidimensional agency measurement extending the A dimension in D = A x L x M from binary to graded. Measures practical versus technical agency across four sub-dimensions.
structural_requirements: Extend A from binary to graded [0,1]
Measure four sub-dimensions: Visibility, Affordability, Controllability, Understandability
decisions_made: Expand agency measurement from binary to graded [0,1] — operational as WEAVER/agency_amplifier.py
Four sub-dimensions defined: V (Visibility), F (Affordability), C (Controllability), U (Understandability)
Equal weight, non-compensatory: A = (V + F + C + U) / 4, any zero collapses A
